title: apply-dns input
description: Create or overwrite one domain's DNS records through dnshelper, after a dry run (DESIGN.md 5.3.4/5.3.5). dnshelper only -- never offered when it's absent or the zone isn't managed.

dry_run.description: Required, not defaulted: the caller must be explicit about previewing vs. executing (DESIGN.md 5.3.5, 'always run a dry_run first').
